# Atomdown

> Atomdown is a backward-compatible block identity and metadata standard for Markdown. It uses XML-shaped directives inside HTML comments, so ordinary Markdown tools remain compatible while agents and applications gain persistent block IDs, groups, and extensible attributes.

Atomdown is useful for Markdown provenance, AI-writing audits, block-level review, stable references, and application metadata. Visible Markdown remains the source of truth.

Core syntax:

<!-- <atomdown version="1"/> -->
<!-- <atom id="4P8W2H6K" slug="claim"/> -->
<!-- <atom-group id="7K3M9X2D" slug="findings"> -->
<!-- </atom-group> -->

Safe editing rules:

1. Preserve all Atomdown comments and unknown attributes.
2. An atom marker applies to the next top-level Markdown block.
3. Keep each directive alone on its source line.
4. Never change an existing ID when moving an item.
5. Generate a new ID when copying an item.
6. Keep atom-group markers balanced; Core 1 does not allow nested groups.
7. Run `atomdown lint FILE` after editing.

## Normative documentation

- [Atomdown Core 1 specification](SPEC.md): Syntax, identity, extensions, mixed Markdown, and conformance requirements.
- [Normalized XML schema](schema/atomdown-1.xsd): XSD 1.0 model for extracted Atomdown metadata.
- [Conformance corpus](testdata/README.md): Valid, mixed, malformed, and golden documents.

## Implementation

- [Go package overview](README.md): Installation, CLI commands, and embedded library examples.
- [Parser](parser.go): CommonMark and Atomdown parsing behavior.
- [Token API](token.go): Lossless Markdown, directive, and whitespace token stream.
- [Extension API](processor.go): Compile-time transform hooks for embedded applications.

Machine-readable commands:

atomdown parse FILE
atomdown tokens FILE
atomdown lint --json FILE
atomdown xml FILE
atomdown strip FILE
atomdown id
